webmentions.content: (Off-topic/meta.) Interestingly, my (h-)feed reader displays a (p-)name for this “note.” Normally, it drops the p-name (and thus considers the post a “note”) if it’s the same as (or a shortened version of) the content. In this case it doesn’t, because this post’s p-name contains a straight quote whereas in the content it’s a “curly” quote. Which raises the question: Why add the p-name class at all, if this a note?
